related_information: • If oil mixes into coolant, perform troubleshooting for “Oil mixes into coolant”. • If any failure code is displayed, perform troubleshooting for that code. If coolant level lowers rapidly and coolant leakage is suspected, perform following troubleshooting.

steps.cause: Breakage of oil cooler element or O-ring
steps.point_to_check: • Check oil cooler element and O-ring • Leakage from oil cooler is detected by pressure test.
steps.remedy: Oil cooler element and O- ring replacement

steps.cause: Breakage of cylinder head or head gasket
steps.point_to_check: Disassemble engine and check cylinder head and head gasket
steps.remedy: Cylinder head and head gasket replacement

steps.cause: Cracking or hole caused by pitting in cylinder block
steps.point_to_check: • Engine oil is increasing and milky. • Disassemble engine and check inside of cylinder block for cracking or hole caused by pitting.
